errors.evidence: The 0-CoT (blue dashed) line ends at x=4 with a y-value just above 0.910 (approximately 0.911). The stated value of 0.914 is a noticeable overestimation.
The CoRe (orange solid) line starts at x=0 with a y-value slightly above 0.960. The value 0.959 corresponds to the starting point of the other line, 0-CoT.
The CoRe (orange solid) line ends at x=4 with a y-value of approximately 0.913. The stated value of 0.918 is a significant overestimation and is much closer to the y-value at x=3 (approx. 0.919).
The description does not explicitly mention that there is a legend in the top right of the plot which identifies the two lines.
